# cortex-ia

cortex-ia is a single Go binary that installs the embedded OpenCode workflow
asset set into your home configuration and manages its MCP server entries.
It configures OpenCode only and never writes anywhere else.

- Installs the base config, AGENTS.md, 14 agents, 9 commands, 21 skills,
  and the plugin under `~/.config/opencode/` from `go:embed` assets; nothing
  is generated at install time.
- Managed MCP services, all registered as native local servers
  (`{"type":"local","command":[...],"enabled":true}`): `cortex`
  (`cortex mcp --tools=agent`) and `forgespec` (`npx -y forgespec-mcp`) by
  default, `context7` (`npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp`) as an unselected
  catalog preset, plus custom local (argv) / remote (URL) servers.
- Transactional by default: plan first, digest-bound confirmation, verified
  backup before any write, one cross-process home lock per mutation,
  rollback on failure, recover for interrupted journals, fail-closed on
  conflicts it does not own.
- CLI: `install`, `sync`, `mcp add|list|remove`, `doctor`, `rollback`,
  `recover [list]|<journal-id>`, `uninstall`, `version`, `help`; running
  with no arguments launches the interactive TUI.
- Installation state, lock, and backups live under `~/.cortex-ia/`.
- Former multi-agent, persona, profile, model, skill-registry, and
  SDD-compiler surfaces were removed and fail with an explicit
  retired-surface error.

Entry points: README.md, docs/quickstart.md, docs/installation.md,
docs/mcp.md, docs/security.md, docs/architecture.md.
